subject: [PATCH v6 03/12] mm: add PMD swap entry splitting support

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue where VM_WARN_ON_ONCE() is compiled out without DEBUG_VM, leading to an uninitialized page in the swap branch. Suggested setting folio and page to NULL when freeze = false.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed that the existing code is overly cautious and suggested restructuring it to make it clearer. Opposed adding unnecessary code.

2026-08-19.patch_summary: The patch adds support for PMD swap entry splitting, but a reviewer pointed out that the code is overly cautious and suggested restructuring it to make it clearer.
